item.title: Rock Bay Harbour Ferry Project - Dredging and Dock Construction
item.description: Possible. Place: British Columbia, CA. Type: Port or marine terminal, Wharf, pier or large dock, Dredging, Shoreline protection, seawall or bulkhead, Piles or pile-supported structure. Project by Ralmax Group of Companies in Rock Bay Harbour, British Columbia. The notice mentions dredging, pile, port or terminal, shoreline protection and wharf or dock work and an area of about 3,000 m2. Official notice: https://iaac-aeic.gc.ca/050/evaluations/proj/90624?culture=en-CA Source: Impact Assessment Agency of Canada, Canadian Impact Assessment Registry.
